blurb.en: Six stages of folding with thru-zero symmetry, and DC-coupled inputs so it will happily fold CV as well.
blurb.fi: Kuusi taittovaihetta thru-zero-symmetrialla, ja DC-kytketyt tulot, joten se taittaa mielellään myös CV:tä.
blurb.sv: Sex vikningssteg med thru-zero-symmetri, och DC-kopplade ingångar så den viker gärna CV också.

reviews.title: Intellijel Designs uFold II Wave Folder & Shaper — product notes

pull.q: The result of a collaboration between Intellijel and David Dixon, the uFold II is an intuitive wavefolder that expands on the original uFold circuit design.

quotes.t: The module has a logical layout that offers maximum tactility, is easy to use with both CV and audio signals, and produces a wide range of timbres.
